Class ProducingIndustry

java.lang.Object
pt.ipp.isep.dei.domain.ProducingIndustry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Industry
public class ProducingIndustry extends Object implements Industry
Industry that produces a single type of cargo each cycle.

A ProducingIndustry generates cargo at a fixed rate per simulation tick, tracks a minimum demand threshold before production, and maintains an internal stock of produced cargo.
